question: Who among the following was the founder and director of Darpana Academy of Performing Arts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mrinalini Sarabhai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai** was an acclaimed Indian classical dancer, choreographer, and instructor.
 
• She founded the **Darpana Academy of Performing Arts** in Ahmedabad in 1949.
 
• The academy focuses on the teaching and promotion of classical dance forms such as Bharatanatyam and Kathakali.
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was awarded numerous accolades, including the **Padma Bhushan(1992)** and **Padma Shri(1965)**, for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• She played a pivotal role in popularizing Indian dance forms both in India and internationally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Darpana Academy of Performing Arts**:

 
 
• Founded in 1949 by Mrinalini Sarabhai and her husband Vikram Sarabhai.
 
• The academy provides training in various performing arts including dance, drama, music, and puppetry.
 
• The institution is also involved in social activism and uses art as a medium for social change.
 
 
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai's Contributions**:
 
 
• She authored several books on dance, including autobiographies and instructional texts.
 
• She choreographed over 300 dance dramas and was a pioneer in using dance as a form of storytelling and expression.
 
 
 
• **Indian Classical Dance**:
 
 
• India has eight classical dance forms: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Sattriya, Manipuri, and Mohiniyattam.
 
• These dance forms are known for their intricate gestures, expressions, and storytelling elements.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**:
 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian awards in India, comprising three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• These awards recognize achievements in various fields such as art, literature, science, and public service.
